outcome: recurrent cardiovascular disease (CVD) events (emergency department visit/hospitalization or death)
cohort: A cohort of 408,666 Victorian women who had a singleton birth between 1999 and 2008, divided into those with a history of preterm delivery (n=34,128) and those with term deliveries (n=374,538).
finding: A history of preterm delivery was associated with a significantly increased risk of recurrent cardiovascular disease events (aHR 1.70).
followup_time: Longitudinal follow-up, with observations extending after birth (1999-2008) up to 2022 (or data cutoff prior to publication), implying a maximum follow-up of up to 23 years.
gest_age: Preterm (<37 weeks) or term (>=37 weeks) singleton births, defining the mother's exposure status.
